summary: An official tells a candidate disqualified by a minute that he likes him but nothing can be done.
realLife: A city mayor said the city could not make an exception for a council candidate recorded as filing his financial form a minute late, because an exception would hurt the election's integrity.
sources: FOX 13 Salt Lake City, council candidate disqualified for filing one minute late, Aug. 13, 2019: https://www.fox13now.com/2019/08/13/draper-city-council-candidate-disqualified-for-filing-documents-one-minute-late
inGame: the clerk's received time; filing deadline record

turns.turn: The mayor holds the line and says why
turns.writesBack: the candidate is off the ballot and the official's regret is in the story

turns.turn: The mayor finds a way to hold a hearing
turns.pulledBy: a sympathetic board and a clerk's own error
turns.writesBack: an appeal and a delayed ruling
